{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter out invalid baseline values
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Correct assay_batch B: divide biomarker_final by 10
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Confirm correction: batch B should now be in ng/mL
batch_b_mean = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()
batch_a_mean = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'A', 'biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()
print(f'Batch B (corrected) mean biomarker_final: {batch_b_mean:.2f} ng/mL')
print(f'Batch A mean biomarker_final: {batch_a_mean:.2f} ng/mL')"}
